target.source: ${tier === "quick" ? "Quick" : "Deep"} completion target: ${seconds} seconds from original job acceptance.
target.text: ${tier === "quick" ? "Quick" : "Deep"} 完成目标：从原始任务被接受起 ${seconds} 秒。

monthly.source: Each Monthly request starts its own target when that original request is accepted, not when the plan is purchased.
monthly.text: 每次 Monthly 请求都在该原始请求被接受时启动自己的计时目标，而不是在购买方案时。

terms.source: This is a provisional target, not a guaranteed completion time. Existing package terms provide no automatic remedy. Keep the original job; do not pay again for recovery.
terms.text: 这是暂定目标，不是保证完成时间。现有套餐条款不提供自动补救。保留原始任务；不要为恢复而再次付款。

unavailable.source: Completion target unavailable for this package version. No timing or refund promise is inferred.
unavailable.text: 此套餐版本的完成目标不可用。不推断任何时间或退款承诺。

localTitle.source: Completion target elapsed since the last status check.
localTitle.text: 自上次状态检查起已超过完成目标。

localBody.source: The last status had no delivered result. Check the original job for current delivery and payment evidence. This local clock warning does not establish its current state or notify a person.
localBody.text: 上次状态没有已交付结果。检查原始任务以获取当前交付和付款证据。此本地时钟警告不证明当前状态，也不会通知任何人。

localObservation.source: This warning uses elapsed browser time after the last server observation. A closed or suspended page cannot guarantee timely display.
localObservation.text: 此警告采用上次服务器观察之后经过的浏览器时间。页面关闭或挂起时无法保证及时显示。

originalOnly.source: Keep the original job and payment reference. Do not pay again to recover this job. Refund policy and execution require owner confirmation; no refund is offered or recorded here.
originalOnly.text: 保留原始任务和付款参考。不为恢复此任务再次付款。退款政策和执行需所有者确认；此处不提供或记录退款。

choiceNotice.source: Choosing guidance only changes this page. It does not submit a request, notify support, resume research or move money.
choiceNotice.text: 选择指引仅会改变此页面。它不会提交请求、通知支持人员、恢复研究或转移资金。

waitBody.source: Keep following the original job with its existing status/recovery controls. Waiting does not restart its target or authorize another purchase.
waitBody.text: 继续使用原始任务现有的状态和恢复控件跟踪任务。等待不会重启计时目标，也不会授权再次购买。

partialBody.source: Ask the owner to review any retained output for explicitly incomplete delivery. No partial result or acceptance is promised by this status; pending payment legs remain protected.
partialBody.text: 请所有者审阅任何留存输出，以明确标示不完整交付。此状态不承诺提供部分结果或验收；等待确认的付款仍受保护。

humanBody.source: Share the original job ID, original payment reference and last recorded stage privately with the owner. This page has not contacted a responder. Uncertain legs require original-only review before any remedy.
humanBody.text: 私下向所有者提供原始任务 ID、原始付款参考和上次记录阶段。此页面未联系响应人员。结果待核实的付款在任何补救前必须仅针对原始记录进行审阅。

reviewBody.source: The last server observation records a failure or a review-required status while the original target has not elapsed. Keep the original job for review; this does not establish current delivery or authorize recovery spending.
reviewBody.text: 服务器最近的观察在原定目标尚未到达时记录了失败或需要审查的状态。请保留原任务以供审查；这不证明当前已交付，也不授予恢复支出权限。

reviewObservation.source: Review is based on the retained server status, not a deadline crossing. This page does not mean that a person has been notified or received the job.
reviewObservation.text: 审查依据是保留的服务器状态，而不是截止时间已过。此页面不表示有人已获通知或收到任务。

reviewTerms.source: A recorded failure or review-required status may need attention before the target elapses. Review does not restart the original target.
reviewTerms.text: 记录的失败或需要审查状态可能需在目标到达前处理。审查不会重置原定目标。

reviewTitle.source: This job needs review before its completion target.
reviewTitle.text: 此任务需要在完成目标到达前审查。
